title: Berlin — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Berlin: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Berlin has a population of 3,677,000. Germany’s dynamic capital, a hub for art, history, tech startups, and culture with a famously affordable cost of living for a major European capital. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Sunshine is limited, with about 84 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.

Last updated: November 07, 2026
